$comment: Miracle Sealants (tile, stone and grout cleaners and sealers, Miracle Sealants Company) runs a WordPress site with server-rendered product pages at the top level (/miracle-sealants-<product>/; the post sitemap lists them). The product name is the h1, the description is the meta description and the image is og:image. Products are sold through retailers and distributors, so there is no price and no stock signal: price and availability are not configured and every product returns price.state unknown with a PRICE_MISSING warning; price_unit usd only keeps currency USD. There are no specs on the page (technical data is in PDF sheets). Engines tried on the sample on 2026-11-19: http: SUCCESS with title, image and description; browser: FETCH_TIMEOUT; ai-crawler-avalai: the same fields at 6,049+563 tokens. http is selected: the same data at no cost. Checked against the saved (curl) Porcelain and Ceramic Tile Scrubbing Cleaner page on 2026-11-19.
